I didn't add `clever k8s update`: permission to write the files was declined, so nothing in the repo has changed.

The work is small because `src/lib/k8s.js:206` already has a `k8sUpdate()` helper that nothing uses yet. It sends a PATCH to `/v4/kubernetes/organisations/{ownerId}/clusters/{clusterId}` and accepts `name`, `description`, `tags` and `features`. The command only needs to call it.

**Planned design**, based on `k8s create` and `oauth-consumers update`:

```bash
clever k8s update <cluster-id|cluster-name> [--name <name>] [--description <description>]
  [--tag tag[,tag...]] [--autoscaling enabled|disabled] [--org <org>] [--format human|json]
```

- Only the options you pass go into the request, so the rest of the cluster's settings stay unchanged. With no option, the command fails with "Nothing to update, use at least one of --name, --description, --tag or --autoscaling".
- `--tag` replaces the current tags, and `--tag ""` removes them all (the existing `tags` parser already turns an empty string into an empty list).
- `--autoscaling` takes `enabled` or `disabled`, because a plain on/off flag could only turn autoscaling on, never off.
- Persistent storage is left out: it can't be removed once added, and `add-persistent-storage` already adds it.
- It uses `since: null` and inherits the `k8s` feature flag from the parent command.

**Files:**
1. A new `src/commands/k8s/k8s.update.command.js`.
2. `src/commands/global.commands.js`: import the command and register it as `update: k8sUpdateCommand` under `k8s`.
3. `docs/kubernetes.md`: an "Update a Cluster" section with examples, placed before "Add persistent storage to a Cluster".
4. Then `npm run docs` to regenerate `k8s.docs.md` and the skill reference, and `npm run validate`. `SKILL.md` doesn't mention any `k8s` commands, so it stays as it is.

I wouldn't run the new command against your account without asking you first, because it changes a real cluster. I'd only run `--help` to check it.

If you allow writes to `src/commands/` and `docs/`, I'll apply this and run the docs and validation steps. Tell me if you'd rather have different flag names or a different scope. AGENTS.md also says every PR must close an existing issue (`Closes #N`), so give me the issue number if there is one.
